claims: Fillip is a stimulus, boost, or unexpected boost that encourages improvement or excitement.
Fillip refers to a sharp, small tap made by snapping a finger against a thumb.
Fillip originated in the 15th century as a word for a sharp, small tap made by snapping a finger against a thumb.
Fillip evolved to mean any small incentive.
Synonyms of fillip include stimulus, boost, encouragement, incentive, impetus, fillip, stimulus, stimulant, embellishment, addition, extra, twist, sparkle.
Antonyms of fillip include block, check, discouragement, hindrance, deterrent.
